entry.desc: Aerosol species types whose mass fraction of each MAM mode makes up the reactive surface for tropospheric heterogeneous chemistry (aero_state%surf_area_dens types_list), as CAM's aerosol_nl sad_chem_spec_types. Valid types are those of radiative_aerosol_definitions: sulfate, ammonium, nitrate, p-organic, s-organic, black-c, seasalt, dust. Unused entries (blank or UNSET) match no species type and are ignored. Used by mam_micm_surface_rates and mam_surfarea_diagnostics.
